input_fields.name: failed_selection_predicate
input_fields.description: One existing selector, its failure/ambiguity, and consuming source location.

input_fields.name: actual_candidate_properties
input_fields.description: Candidate geometry/state properties available for discrimination.

input_fields.name: target_semantics
input_fields.description: Target direction, position, normal, area, bounds, topology, adjacency, or type.

result_fields.name: corrected_selector
result_fields.description: One copyable selector expression using semantic fields.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when properties do not make one target unique.

procedure: Map each target semantic requirement to a candidate property.
Construct one predicate using the smallest justified direction/position/normal/area/bounds/topology/adjacency set.
Return selector, fields, rejected candidates, and a uniqueness assertion.
If no unique predicate is justified, return needs_manual_review and no positional fallback.
rejection_rules: Reject insufficient properties, unresolved semantics, zero/multiple matches, or arbitrary FaceN/BodyN/list-index selectors.
Do not include topology repair or geometry changes.
